Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage

Class StorageRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.StorageRegistry
public final class StorageRegistry extends Object
Registry for storage providers allowing lookup by name. Providers should be initialized by the host plugin (or a bootstrap component) before being used.
